ev_0004.summary: Figure is a quadrilateral-like sketch with vertices O (bottom-left), A (bottom-right), T (top), B (upper-left). Explicit paths: O-A horizontal base; O-B vertical left side; B-T upper-left edge; T-A right edge; O-T diagonal. All strokes solid. Labels T, B, O, A already correctly bound to point_01, point_04, point_02, point_03 (no bindings changed). Junctions are the four labelled vertices only; no interior feet, no curve, no right-angle marks, no dashed endpoints. angle_marks and feet are empty.

payload.notes: Coordinates A, B, O, T are program-owned and not redefined; the document will only compile when the program inserts them at the start of the tikzpicture. Labels use the 14/16.8 pt font from the metrics, with T above, B left, O below-left and A below-right. No extra libraries are loaded, since none are needed.

params.instruction: Draw a figure with four labelled vertices and solid edges only, using measured pixel points (image origin top-left, y down; flip y for TikZ, image height 558, so y_tikz = 558 - y_px, or use any consistent scale). Vertices (verified labels from the original): O at px (69.33, 491.61); A at px (446.66, 491.0); B at px (69.0, 207.6); T at px (304.96, 66.48). Edges (all solid, no dashes): OA, OB, BT, TA, and the diagonal OT. Do NOT add a right-angle square mark at O: the original shows none (detector also found none). Label letters: T above its vertex, B to the left of B, O below-left of O, A below-right of A, rendered in math mode as $T$, $B$, $O$, $A$. Use one shared coordinate definition for each vertex. Keep the figure plain black line work, no fill, no extra points.
